title: Case 016: New Tenant Has Moved In
initial_request: Northmere Mutual already knows that 116 Rowan Walk, Brackenford, ZZ2 7ZZ is rented. I am reporting a change of tenant to Ashdown Cover, but I do not yet have the move-in date needed for a complete notification to the insurer.
overview: Archie confirmed by phone that the new tenant was already living at the property. Liv asked for the move-in date, Archie supplied it without sharing unnecessary tenant details, and Liv notified Northmere Mutual of the change. The case record confirms that the information was sent; no change to policy terms is stated.

next_action.summary: Confirm the tenant's move-in date with Archie, then notify the insurer of the change.

outcome: The change was passed to the insurer; no change to policy terms has been stated.

events.body: Northmere Mutual already knows that 116 Rowan Walk, Brackenford, ZZ2 7ZZ is let. I am reporting the tenant change to you now, but I do not yet have the new tenant's exact move-in date for you to include in the insurer notification.
The new tenant is already living at the property. I can check the exact move-in date and send it to you.
Please confirm the exact date the new tenant moved in so I can complete the notification to Northmere Mutual. I do not need the tenant's contact details for this update.
The new tenant moved in on 6 May. Please use that date to complete the tenant-change notification to Northmere Mutual.
I am notifying you that the tenant at 116 Rowan Walk, Brackenford, ZZ2 7ZZ changed, and the new tenant moved in on 6 May. The property remains let; no tenant contact details are included.
The tenant-change information, including the move-in date, has been sent to Northmere Mutual. This records notification only; no change to policy terms has been stated.
